supporting_observations.claim: The observed PowerShell process ran on WS-MLOPEZ-01 at 13:44:39 UTC as omar.haddad, using the organization's documented patch-deployment script, \\FILE-HD-01\IT\Deploy-Patches.ps1.
A network logon for omar.haddad on WS-MLOPEZ-01 was recorded at 13:42:39 UTC from WS-OHADDAD-01, followed by assignment of the listed elevated privileges.
The PowerShell process launched wusa.exe to install a Windows 11 KB update, consistent with the documented patching activity and deployment script.
The workstation made a Windows Update download through the proxy during the patch activity, with a Windows Update Agent user agent and approximately 38.8 MB received.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records show the PowerShell command line but not the contents or integrity of Deploy-Patches.ps1. (T024-00111, T024-00112)
The observed PowerShell launch is at 13:44:39 UTC; the records do not establish whether another window appeared at the reported approximate time of 13:40 UTC. (T024-00111, T024-00112)
claims_not_established: Whether the user saw this specific PowerShell window or whether it was the window described in the ticket.
Whether the deployed script's contents were unchanged and authorized; the command line alone does not show the script body. (T024-00111, T024-00112)
